item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: MicroGroove
  • 発売日: 2012-06-01
  • スコア: 6.08/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 縄―紅い傷痕―
  • 英語名: Nawa -Akai Kizuato-

别名

  • 縄－紅い傷痕－

あらすじ

Born into the Sakimori family, a lineage of rope masters, Souichi is the son of a renowned kinbaku artist.

After the death of his father, Gentarou, Souichi begins a new life with his mother, Yoshie—just the two of them now.

Trying to be considerate of his mother, who’s been left alone, Souichi reflects on his relationship with his late father as they adjust to their new reality.
